faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What is Tricolink and how does it work?
faq.a1: Tricolink turns a long URL into a short link. When someone opens the short link, we redirect them to the original address and count the click.
faq.a2: Yes. You can shorten links for free, and creating an account adds history and management tools.
faq.q3: Why should I shorten a URL?
faq.a3: Short links are easier to share, look cleaner and let you follow how many people clicked.
faq.a4: We only redirect to http and https addresses, never store IP addresses and mark short-link redirects as noindex.
faq.q5: How do I shorten a link?
faq.a5: Paste the URL into the field on the home page and select Shorten. The short link appears right away.
faq.a6: Signed-in users can choose a custom alias when the code is available.
faq.a7: Anonymous links expire automatically. Signed-in users can set or remove an expiry date for each link.
faq.q8: Do you store my IP address?
faq.a8: No. Click statistics keep only the country provided by the edge network, plus device, browser and referring host.
